motivation: Palmer colony counts and chick production identify short-term history dependence, but the biological carrier of that history remains uncertain.

observables.B_i_t: breeding-pair count for colony i in year t
observables.S_i_t: relative reproductive-performance state frozen in PALMER_PERFORMANCE_REDISTRIBUTION_LAGS_V2

latent_transition_decomposition.A: surviving local adults that attend and breed at colony i
latent_transition_decomposition.M: net movement of already mature birds into minus out of colony i
latent_transition_decomposition.J: first-time recruitment into the observed breeding population at colony i
latent_transition_decomposition.attendance_note: A combines adult survival, site retention and breeding propensity because non-breeding adults are not observed in the census.

carrier_coefficients.observable_total: The breeder-count response identifies theta_total = theta_A + theta_M + theta_J unless external information separates components.

primary_identifiability_tests.T1_design_rank: Show that a regression using the same observed S_i,t column for attendance, movement and recruitment has identical design columns; only their sum is estimable.
primary_identifiability_tests.T2_transition_map_rank: For K colonies, the observation map y = A + M + J has Jacobian [I I I], rank K and nullity 2K before further constraints.
primary_identifiability_tests.T3_within_island_movement_conservation: Even imposing sum_i M_i,t = 0 leaves more latent dimensions than K breeder-count observations for K >= 2.
primary_identifiability_tests.T4_twin_generators: Construct attendance-driven and movement-driven latent histories that produce exactly the same B_i,t+1 for the same S_i,t while satisfying nonnegative observed breeder counts.

decision_rule.carrier_identifiable_from_counts: true only if all frozen rank/nullity checks give zero latent nullity and the twin-generator equality fails

external_data_gate.historical_evidence: Palmer/Humble studies banded approximately 1000 Adelie chicks annually and standardized searches for returning banded birds, so individual encounter histories existed historically.
external_data_gate.public_search_result: No public individual ID x year x breeding-colony encounter-history table was located in the currently indexed Palmer ERDDAP/EDI/USAP sources during this audit.
external_data_gate.currently_public_tracking: 2018/19-2024/25 Palmer GPS/dive data are public but target foraging movement rather than historical breeding-colony transitions.
minimum_data_to_break_confounding: individual resight histories with colony and breeding status
or counts of breeding and identifiable non-breeding adults by colony/year

interpretation_boundaries: Do not infer adult dispersal, breeding propensity, retention or first recruitment as the unique carrier from breeder counts alone.
A significant past-performance bridge coefficient does not remove this structural confounding.
External literature may motivate a mechanism but cannot identify which mechanism generated the Palmer count series.
The result is an identifiability statement, not evidence that all latent mechanisms are equally biologically plausible.
